TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_SOYUZ.title: Sovetsky Soyuz
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_SOYUZ.talk.first: I am Sovetsky Soyuz, the lead ship of Project 23 battleships. Here are your supplies.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_SOYUZ.talk.TASHK: It may not compare to the joy of receiving a gift from Commander, but I'll gladly accept it.
Excellent. Everything proceeds according to plan.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_SOYUZ.talk.ANY.0: Use the power I grant you as you wish. As always, I will support your decisions.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_SOYUZ.talk.ANY.1: Planning and efficiency are the foundation of survival in this world. State your choice without delay.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_SOYUZ.talk.ANY.2: Leave the logistics to me. You may focus entirely on the primary objective.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_SOYUZ.talk.ANY.3: I have absolute confidence in your abilities.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_SOYUZ.talk.TASHK: The mission rewards have arrived and been fully accounted for. Make your choice.
